about: Craft checklist, department editing_colour (P3b, docs/CRAFT_CURRICULUM.md). Same shape as training/video_criteria.json, plus artefact (the field the check reads), source (docs/research/CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10.md section and verdict, the repository rule, or 'Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified)') and enforced_by (an existing path, a planned validator with its phase in planned, or manual). check = code (a validator measures it), critic (the script-critic or editorial review ticks it), eye (the creator's or Claude's look at the frames), manual (a person does it). Every number is a BP id in sourced_rules.json; nothing here is binding: no row has two verified source types yet. Skill: .claude/skills/video-editing-architect/SKILL.md.

criteria.name: every cut decided by the Rule of Six in its order (emotion first, sacrifice from the bottom)
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §10 (SUPPORTED): No Film School on Murch's Rule of Six: the order and emotion's 51 %

criteria.name: never cut without a reason
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): Dmytryk, On Film Editing, not opened (CRAFT_SOURCES §10)

criteria.name: a cut inside an action lands 2-4 frames after the motion begins
every rendered shot keeps its handles at both ends
hard cut by default; a dissolve only at a change of place or time
an occlusion wipe is used only as an invisible cut (a silhouette crosses the lens), never as a visible transition
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): V3 proposal, creator decision pending (conflict 6)

criteria.name: whips and flashes are spaced and open a story turn
whip, speed ramp and rack focus keep their durations
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): whip 8-10 f, ramp 1.0/1.6/0.45 x 0.6 s, rack focus 0.4 s (CRAFT_SOURCES §10)

criteria.name: every shot's boundary frames match the scene's master frame within a bounded transfer
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §11 (PARTIAL): Reinhard et al. 2001, colour transfer by mean and std (search summaries)

criteria.name: hero costume and skin swatches stay inside a delta-E band across the episode
criteria.source: Blueprint 2026-10 (unverified): no band number; calibrate on the hero sheets (CRAFT_SOURCES §11)

criteria.name: one constant film look over the whole episode
criteria.source: repo: ED-04 and production/assemble.py LOOK; BP-131 records the Blueprint's numbers

criteria.name: delivery frame rate 24 fps, the video clips' native rate (D-85, creator-confirmed 2026-10-31); D-30's 30 fps is superseded
criteria.source: CRAFT_SOURCES_2026-10 §16 (SUPPORTED): YouTube Help 1722171: 24, 25, 30, 48, 50, 60 fps are all common
